data.body: CONFORMANCE RE-CHECK: R1-R6 all RESOLVED, no new divergences; R2 confirmed to match upstream's own fix (pydantic-ai PR 6868 'Copy extra_headers before setdefault'). Four real problems found and fixed: (1) ee8a's vendor-scan AC was UNSATISFIABLE — it scanned for bare 'langfuse_', which occurs 42 times across 10 files as rebar's own legitimate vocabulary (langfuse_prompt, LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY); now scans only header-shaped literals x-litellm-/helicone-/x-langfuse-, each verified zero-occurrence. (2) 6cd0 had two CONTRADICTORY ACs: 'two runs differ' unconditionally vs 'trace_id equals the recording span's id' — under one coarse caller span every run inherits the same id; the differing-runs AC is now scoped 'absent an enclosing recording span' with the inheritance caveat stated. (3) 26ae's non-mutation and merge-precedence ACs cannot be proven from build_model_settings' return value; the Testing section now names the httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport intercept. (4) ee8a's $$ rule now adopts OTel's general $$->$ everywhere rather than only $${. S1 rewritten 7414, S3 rewritten 7185-ish, S2 7509.
